title: Contact InVaal[016]
intro: InVaal[016] connects people, businesses, creatives, organisations and opportunities across the Vaal community.

contact_topics.title: General Enquiries
contact_topics.description: Have a question, suggestion or idea about InVaal[016]? Get in touch with us.

contact_topics.title: Local Businesses
contact_topics.description: Contact us about local businesses, business information, listings and opportunities for businesses to connect with the community.

contact_topics.title: Events
contact_topics.description: Share information about community events, markets, entertainment, workshops and activities happening around the Vaal.

contact_topics.title: Opportunities
contact_topics.description: Let us know about jobs, bursaries, grants, tenders, learnerships, training programmes and other opportunities that could benefit the community.

contact_topics.title: Creatives
contact_topics.description: Connect with us if you're a musician, filmmaker, photographer, designer, artist, writer or another local creative.

contact_topics.title: Community
contact_topics.description: Share community initiatives, projects, stories and information that can help people across the Vaal.

contact_topics.title: Partnerships
contact_topics.description: Organisations, businesses and community groups interested in working with InVaal[016] are welcome to connect with us.

contact_topics.title: Advertising
contact_topics.description: Businesses and organisations can contact InVaal[016] to explore ways of reaching the local community.

contact_topics.title: Corrections & Updates
contact_topics.description: Found information that is outdated, incorrect or needs updating? Let us know so we can review it.

community.title: InVaal[016] belongs to the community.
community.message: Local information becomes more useful when the community helps keep it accurate, relevant and active.

disclaimer: InVaal[016] may share information originating from external organisations and sources. Please verify important information with the relevant official organisation.
